scenarios.what: plural and agreement branches collapsed to one Chinese form: ' person'/' persons' (inset label and readout \text{}) to 个人 / \text{人}, ' story'/' stories' (building label and readout \text{}) to 层 / \text{层}, 'is'/'are' in the running headline dropped, and the done headline's N.v === 1 branch ('One story of about …' vs 'N stories of about … each') merged into N.v + ' 层，每层约 … m，楼高约 … m。'

feet, inches, yards, square yards and square inches named in prose as 英尺、英寸、码、平方码、平方英寸 ('feet/inches' to 英尺/英寸, 'converting to feet' to 换算成英尺, 'in square inches' to 以平方英寸计, the sim's 'less than a foot' to 不到一英尺, its sim-head 'in feet' to 以英尺为单位); the symbols in., ft, yd kept as printed in spans, math and figure labels
scenarios.why: a unit with no SI equivalent keeps its symbol and takes the target name in prose (translate.md 4.4)
